_source: Claude Partner Network Services Track, anthropic.com/news/services-track-partner-hub (Jun 3 2026). Thresholds below are the published ones. 'Registered' is the program entry level for new applicants.

Registered.note: Entry level for new applicants. Legitimate services firm, clean checks, commitment to 10 certified practitioners.

Global Premier.also_requires: Joint business plan with named executive sponsors (human only)

definitions.active_certified: Person with a current (unexpired) Anthropic certification who used Claude in the past 90 days, on an email at the firm's own domain.
definitions.joint_customer: Customer org in Claude account data with production usage in the trailing 12 months and the applicant as partner of record.
definitions.public_story: A published customer story URL that returns 200, needs no login, and names both the firm and Claude.

agent_owns: Reading applications and every system of record
Verifying the certified bench, joint customers, public stories, CRM history and screening
Placing a clean new applicant at Registered or Select, exactly as the verified numbers support
Linking an exact duplicate submission to the original
human_checkpoint: Any tier above Select, including upgrades
Claims that do not match the systems of record
Compliance screening that is not clear
Channel conflict with a direct enterprise account
A customer already attributed to another partner
An existing partner account on the same domain
Instructions to the reviewer embedded in applicant text
Sending any email outside the company
